description: Implements ADR-005 decision 8 (rights portion). Per-user export (download full fingerprint — was a Future/Ideas item, now mandatory) and erasure on request AND on subscription cancellation. Cheap because each user is a self-contained /data/users/<userId>/.zug directory: zip it to export, delete it (plus control-plane rows) to erase. Wire erasure into the Stripe cancellation/downgrade path. Acceptance: a user can export their data and request deletion; deletion removes all file + SQLite state for that userId.
title: GDPR data-subject rights: export + erasure
